title: v4.3.0 · 精选技能策展与验证流程升级
highlights: Curate four existing skills against current upstream evidence without altering public names or paths
Improve context-compaction decision handoffs and distinguish static from behavioral verification
Document optional Neon Jev reranking with authorization, tenant filters, costs and RRF fallback
Discover actual AKS tool schemas instead of inventing a fixed MCP action
release_gates: Exact PR head and merged-main Repository Validation, provenance and CodeQL pass
Zero open Code Scanning alerts on main before publishing
Complete repository validation, installer tests and generator idempotence pass
Downloaded source/npm archives, manifest and SHA256SUMS match exact merged-main commit

validation_boundaries.upstream: Only selected changes from reviewed Neon, Superpowers and Azure source ranges were absorbed. Addy/Lark heads were unchanged; remaining Simota and other upstream artifacts are not claimed fully synchronized.
validation_boundaries.licensing: No unreviewed bulk third-party replacement; existing attribution and license checks retained.
validation_boundaries.runtime: Static tests do not certify live Azure/Neon integration or independent model behavior evaluation.
validation_boundaries.security: Code Scanning zero-open gate covers configured GitHub scanning only, not every vulnerability.
validation_boundaries.previous_release: The existing v4.2.0 tag (30cf0bef) was published on 2026-10-23 and later rolled back from main; it is intentionally left untouched. v4.3.0 is a fresh tag containing this new curated main lineage.

compatibility_notes: Canonical skill names and existing client installer paths are unchanged
Jev reranking is optional and requires available model access and authorization
